answer: At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a oasis tag. The ocean cap is enforced at intake and spiral publishes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, as every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The deposit is 36 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
